grain_rationale: The profile shows 44721 rows with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so each source row is a distinct invoice line event and the transaction grain holds. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id has 2330 distinct values across 44721 rows, stock_code has 3141), so a derived identity over the tuple invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, unit_price identifies a line; with zero exact duplicates this tuple absorbs nothing and uniquely keys each row's observed combination.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document identifier grouping lines into a single invoice; samples like 489434 and 489435 are numeric-looking codes stored as strings, with 2330 distinct invoices and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag marking whether the line belongs to a cancellation, with exactly two distinct values (true, false) and null_rate 0.0, consistent with the negative quantities observed in the quantity samples.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code identifying the item sold; samples like 10002R and 10123C show alphanumeric codes, 3141 distinct values, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '11 PC CERAMIC TEA SET POLKADOT'; nullable with null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), likely missing for uncatalogued or adjustment stock codes.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units sold on the line, additive across rows, ranging from -1395 to 5184 with negative sample values indicating cancellation or return lines; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice event; samples such as 2009-12-01T07:45:00 resolve to the minute with seconds always zero, spanning 2009-12-01 to 2009-12-23, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Per-unit price of the item on the line, ranging from 0.00 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0; zero-priced samples suggest giveaway or adjustment lines.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier (12346 to 18287) that labels rather than measures, so it maps as a dimension; nullable with null_rate 0.300664 (13446 nulls), likely guest or unidentified purchases.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country for the invoice, with 24 distinct values such as Australia, EIRE, and Germany and null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row is a single invoice line: a product (stock_code) invoiced at a quantity and unit price on a specific invoice at a specific minute, including cancellation lines flagged by is_cancellation with negative quantities.
purpose: Declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category: the time column and minute grain, the transaction grain with a derived line identity, and the dimension/measure role of every mapped column. It is consumed by the deterministic modeling engine, which emits the gold models from this declaration.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft (gold_invoice_lines_mapping), validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; nothing in it executes directly.
limitations: The mapping does not transform, filter, or derive columns beyond the declared line identity: cancellation lines (is_cancellation true, negative quantities down to -1395) and zero-priced lines (unit_price min 0.0) are mapped as-is, and their exclusion or netting is left to consumers. It also does not resolve the 30.0664% null customer_id rows to any surrogate customer, and it carries no quality rules, ownership, or access policies, which review owns.
